title: Lists
story: A <ul> is a bulleted list and an <ol> is numbered. Each item is an <li>.
goal: Make a bulleted list of 3 fruits, and a numbered list of 3 steps to make tea.
starter:
Fruits

Making tea

tests.label: Items have text
tests.js: return $$("li").every(function (l) { return txt(l).length > 1; }) || "an li is empty"

hints: <ul> holds <li> items. <ol> works the same way.

Fruits

  • Mango
  • Banana
  • Guava

Making tea

  1. Boil water
  2. Add tea leaves
  3. Pour and enjoy
socratic: Which tag decides bullets or numbers?
Can you put an <li> outside a list?
How would you nest a list inside an item?
explain: In one sentence: what did you learn from “Lists”?
